name: ios-seek-bad
prompt: Tap once on the white "Seek" text immediately to the RIGHT of "Near" and immediately to the LEFT of the two-line "See / Mis" text. This is the Seek Bad control; the rest of its label is intrinsically clipped. These controls are in the blue seek row directly below Clear / Play / Play Null / Pause / Stop and above Src A / Src B. Click within the white text itself, not in a neighboring control. If this row is visible, do not scroll; scrolling cannot unclip these labels. Stop after that single tap.

name: ios-seek-null
prompt: Tap once on the FIRST white "Seek" text immediately to the RIGHT of the two-line "See / Mis" text. This is the Seek Null control; its distinguishing suffix is intrinsically clipped. Do not skip to the second or third "Seek" on that side. These controls are in the blue seek row directly below Clear / Play / Play Null / Pause / Stop and above Src A / Src B. Click within the white text itself, not in a neighboring control. If this row is visible, do not scroll; scrolling cannot unclip these labels. Stop after that single tap.

name: ios-seek-text
prompt: Tap once on the SECOND white "Seek" text to the RIGHT of the two-line "See / Mis" text. There are three consecutive controls with the identical visible label "Seek" on that side; tap the MIDDLE one of those three. This is the Seek Text control; its distinguishing suffix is intrinsically clipped. These controls are in the blue seek row directly below Clear / Play / Play Null / Pause / Stop and above Src A / Src B. Click within the white text itself, not in a neighboring control. If this row is visible, do not scroll; scrolling cannot unclip these labels. Stop after that single tap.

name: ios-seek-nan
prompt: Tap once on the THIRD white "Seek" text to the RIGHT of the two-line "See / Mis" text. There are three consecutive controls with the identical visible label "Seek" on that side; tap the LAST one of those three, just before the label that looks like "Seel". This is the Seek NaN control; its distinguishing suffix is intrinsically clipped. These controls are in the blue seek row directly below Clear / Play / Play Null / Pause / Stop and above Src A / Src B. Click within the white text itself, not in a neighboring control. If this row is visible, do not scroll; scrolling cannot unclip these labels. Stop after that single tap.
